newsitem.title: NORWAY: Orkla sells Frionor stake to N. Seafoods.
newsitem.headline: Orkla sells Frionor stake to N. Seafoods.

text.p: Norway's food-based conglomerate Orkla ASA will sell its shares in frozen-food company Frionor AS to Norway Seafoods ASA in exchange for stock in Norway Seafoods, Oslo Bourse said on Wednesday.
The bourse said RGI estimated annual synergy effects from the planned transaction would amount to 100 million crowns for Norway Seafood.
It said synergy effects included more own production of foodstuff, more efficient distribution and a reduction of costs in general.
NWS had a pre-tax profit of 22.8 million crowns in 1995.
Following the transaction, RGI will hold 54.8 percent of NWS shares.
The transaction will give Orkla a shareholding in NWS of approximately 10.6 percent, raising its total shareholding in NWS to about 16.8 percent.

The statement said Orkla also had an option on a further two million NWS shares at 54 crowns per share. If Orkla fully exercises the option, which expires on August 31, 1998, its total shareholding in NWS will be about 19 percent.
The agreements are subject to the approval of the NWS shareholders' meeting. The parties intend to complete the transaction by the end of January next year.
